Name: DMC Sparda Manor Decorations
Author: VegetaBul
Description:
我已经绘制了通过无人机能看清的所有家具……在老宅入口左侧还有一个其实盔甲，可用“装甲”替代；墙壁上有多盏蜡烛灯（忘记摆了），可用原版家具替代。
建筑mod使用的是 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32564]HxW Restaurant[/url]，1.7 后我会自己绘制一个更符合原设定的map。。。或许。
该mod包含[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42827]事务所家具[/url]

[b]安装说明：[/b]
[list]
[*]下载安装前置mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url]﻿
[*]下载安装本mod（像往常一样）
[*]运行游戏，找[b]罗宾[/b]购买 [b]Sparda庄园目录[/b]
[*]可以开始装修了
[/list]
[b]关于大花窗：[/b]尺寸过大以致上墙效果不佳，因此我额外做了个摆件版本的窗户。但是摆件不能变色，所以晚上透过窗子，你看到的仍会是早晨的景色。
[b]关于秋千：[/b]碰撞箱默认从左下开始，所以你无法从左侧草丛路过。

[b]关于mod中使用的素材的说明：[/b]
当然，设计者为kpk。
树的素材来源为[url=https://karsiori.itch.io/free-pixel-art-tree-pack]FREE Pixel Art Tree Pack by karsiori[/url].

——————————————————————————————————————
I have already drawn all the furniture that can be clearly seen from DMC5 Camera Tools (thx to Otis_Inf). There is also an actual suit of armor on the left side of the old house entrance. You may substitute it with “armor” (“装甲” in Chinesse, I don't know its Engilsh). Candle sconce in the manor can be replaced with SDV vanilla furniture (I forgot to place them).
This mod contains the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42827]DMC Shop Furniture[/url]

The building mod used here is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32564]HxW Restaurant[/url]﻿. After version 1.7, I may draw a new map myself that better matches the original setting… maybe...

[b]Installation:[/b]
[list]
[*]Download and install the prerequisite mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url].
[*]Download and install this mod (as usual).
[*]Launch the game. Purchase [i][b]Sparda Manor Catalogue[/b][/i] from [i][b]Robin[/b][/i].
[*]You can then start decorating.

[/list]
[b]About the large Tracery Window:[/b]
Because the size is too large, it does not display well when placed on walls. Therefore, I also made a decorative/ placeable version. However, decorative objects cannot change colour in the night, so when you look through the window at night, you will still see a morning scene.

[b]About the swing:[/b]
The bounding box size starts from the bottom-left corner by default, so you cannot walk past it through the grass from the left side.

[b]Asset credits:[/b]
Of course, the design belongs to Capcom.
Tree assets are from [url=https://karsiori.itch.io/free-pixel-art-tree-pack]FREE Pixel Art Tree Pack by karsiori[/url].
